description: One industry: metadata + a top sample of its member providers (ranked, with the total). Use find_providers?industry=slug for the full list, or view=full here. Results carry `next`: the sub-resources that exist for this entity and the exact tool call that retrieves each, computed from this record. Pass include_next=false to omit it.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include_next.description: Set false to omit the `next` affordance block.

slug.description: Industry slug, as find_industries returns it, e.g. "artificial-intelligence".

name: get_industry
